info.name: Event Ticketing & Management System - Backend API
info.description:
Full backend API collection generated from the Node.js/Express + MongoDB backend (auth, events, categories, ticket tiers, tickets, payments/Razorpay, analytics).

## Setup
1. Set the `baseUrl` collection variable (default `http://localhost:3009`).
2. Run **Auth > Register User**, verify the email (check console/log for the link if email isn't configured), then run **Auth > Login** — this auto-saves `accessToken`/`refreshToken`/`userId` as collection variables used by every other request.
3. For admin-only routes, log in with a user whose `role` is `admin` (see `seedAdmin.js` in the backend, or promote a user directly in MongoDB).
4. Typical happy-path flow: Category > Create Category → Event > Create Event → Ticket Tier > Create Ticket Tier → Ticket > Purchase Ticket → Payment > Create Razorpay Order → (complete checkout on the client / Razorpay test mode) → Payment > Verify Payment.

All protected routes use collection-level Bearer auth (`{{accessToken}}`); public routes override this with 'No Auth'.
